title: Localization Entry
description: Schema for a single localizable text entry in the OoT/SoH corpus

id.description: Stable identifier. For vanilla messages: hex ID like '0x2034'. For synthetic: SYSTEM::SOURCE_FILE::KEY

id_numeric.description: Numeric message ID (e.g. 0x2034) if from vanilla/custom message system, null otherwise

source_language.description: Canonical source language for this entry

source_file.description: Relative path to the source file containing this text

source_line_start.description: Starting line number in source file

source_line_end.description: Ending line number in source file

system.description: Which text system this entry belongs to

context_hint.description: Additional context about when/where this text appears

raw_text.description: Text with all control codes preserved exactly as in source

plain_text.description: Human-readable text with control codes replaced by friendly markers

control_codes.description: List of control code types found in this message

button_glyphs.description: Button references found (A, B, C-Up, L, R, Z, etc.)

choices.description: Choice labels if this is a choice message

page_count.description: Number of text pages in this message

has_color_codes.description: Whether message contains color control codes

has_sound_codes.description: Whether message contains sound effect codes

has_button_prompt.description: Whether message contains controller button references

german_text.description: German text if available from source, null otherwise

french_text.description: French text if available from source, null otherwise
